_readme: scripts/backfill-scope-role.mjs assigns firms[].scope and firms[].role from
deterministic rules (aumVal, sole-ICE-contract tag). Those rules are right for
the bulk of the database but cannot tell a single-contract LLC from ExxonMobil:
both are aumVal 0 with one harm tag. This file is where that judgment lives, in
the open, one reviewable line per firm.
A firm needs an entry here if the rules would give it the wrong scope. In
practice that means any firm whose harmScore exceeds its rule-assigned cap:
narrow 65, single_company 79, multi_company 94, systemic 100. Without an entry
it gets capped, so an 80+ score always has a written justification behind it.
role: actor = the harm is this entity's own conduct; owner = it is realized
through portfolio companies; both = it operates and owns.
